positive.description: Discover, inspect and run an explicitly authorized research App
positive.prompt: Find the seeded App named LCM Review Market Sizing, inspect its inputs, and run it once for its configured public research topic. I authorize this exact App run.
positive.tools_triggered: search_catalog, get_app, get_app_structure, run_app, get_app_run, read_run_output
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact seeded App, inspect its no-input run contract and current revision, then start one authorized execution. Track the returned run ID and present findings with original sources, following output and manifest pages for complete requested coverage. Do not start a different App.

positive.description: Create a reusable workflow without starting a run
positive.prompt: Create a simple public-source competitor research App. Show me the built App before starting it; do not run it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Create only one App, track its builder job and inspect result.success, app_template_id and revision. Show the generated workflow and declared inputs. Do not start a run; an edit or execution requires a separate explicit request.

positive.description: Research a narrow public question with sources
positive.prompt: Use FifthRow Answers to identify two German ball-bearing manufacturers and cite their official websites.
positive.expected_behavior: Use public input only, accept background work promptly, retain the original run ID, and return source-supported findings after completion. Describe available assessment honestly. Offer deeper App research only when useful to the user's goal.

positive.description: Read account context and reuse permitted company evidence
positive.prompt: Show which FifthRow account I connected, find our saved competitor research and related datasets, and summarize recent company research activity with sources.
positive.tools_triggered: get_account_info, search_knowledge, search_documents, read_document, search_datasets, company_activity, get_lcm_guidance
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the signed-in account and permitted company evidence; preserve document citations and paging. Empty data is reported honestly. A reviewer account must contain nonconfidential sample documents, datasets and prior runs.

positive.description: Inspect and explicitly invoke an existing automation
positive.prompt: Find my seeded automation named LCM Review Weekly Research, show its schedule and target, and invoke it once now. I authorize this exact invocation.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact seeded schedule, show its configured target and notifications, invoke it only once under the user's explicit authorization, and track its returned execution ID with available sources. Do not change the recurring schedule.
